acceptanceCriteria: ticket create reports an existing open ticket with identical title, body and acceptance criteria (warning or refusal with an explicit override), with a test
the behaviour is specified in the Tasks spec
body: Observed 2026-10-16 (build 558). V1-1282 (created 2026-10-12T02:30:34Z) and V1-1283 (15 s later) have byte-identical title, body, acceptanceCriteria and dependencies; V1-1283 was delivered and completed, V1-1282 stayed OPEN in the v1-0 milestone until a lane spent ~50 min re-auditing it, then it was archived as a duplicate. Likely a retried create with a fresh --request-id. Expected: create warns or refuses (named code, override flag) when an open ticket has identical title+body+acceptanceCriteria, or search exposes a content digest so filers can deduplicate cheaply. Actual: silent duplicate.
title: corvint-tasks ticket create accepts a content-identical ticket under a new ID (V1-1282 duplicated V1-1283)
